from collections import deque

def components(arr,bg,rmax):
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    R,C=arr.shape
    for r in range(rmax):
      for c in range(C):
        color=arr[r,c]
        if color==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while q:
          y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
            if 0<=ny<rmax and 0<=nx<C and (ny,nx) not in seen and arr[ny,nx]==color:
              seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
        comps.append((int(color),cells))
    return comps

def canvases(arr,bg):
    R,C=arr.shape; segs=[]; r=0
    while r<R:
      if np.all(arr[r]==bg): r+=1; continue
      s=r
      while r<R and not np.all(arr[r]==bg): r+=1
      e=r-1
      # determine frame/bg by row
      border=int(arr[s,0]); fill=int(arr[s,1])
      segs.append((s,e,border,fill))
    return segs

def transfer(arr):
    bg=int(np.bincount(arr.ravel()).argmax())

    cs=canvases(arr,bg)
    firstpanel=min((x[0] for x in cs),default=arr.shape[0])

      dy=e-maxr
      for r,c in cells:
        out[r+dy,c]=border
    return out
